name: archive-index-lock-retry
title: Bounded retry on transient index.lock during archive auto-commit
description: task.py archive's auto-commit dies when another process briefly holds .git/index.lock; no retry exists in safe_commit.py or git.py, so a routine archive fails mid-move under any concurrent git activity (IDE, status daemons, parallel sessions); add a short bounded backoff-retry on the transient lock and a clean abort path that leaves the task move consistent; relocated from the sd-ai-command-pack upstream handoff register (08-04-trellis-upstream-archive-commit-lock-retry).
creator: sdelmas
